cohort: 80 women who underwent obstetric hysterectomy at Government Rajaji Hospital in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India between January 2021 and December 2022
finding: The incidence of obstetric hysterectomy was 2.56 per 1000 deliveries, with abnormal placentation being the leading cause, followed by atonic PPH, traumatic PPH, sepsis, and secondary PPH.
